cards.example_en: An elderly passenger offered me a seat on the bus.
cards.example_zh: 一位年长的乘客在公交车上把座位让给了我。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：广泛的
cards.example_en: Extensive damage followed the storm that hit the coast.
cards.example_zh: 袭击海岸的风暴造成了大范围破坏。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：否定的
cards.example_en: Try not to give a negative reply before you listen.
cards.example_zh: 听别人说完之前，尽量不要给出否定的答复。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：迅速地
cards.example_en: The river rose rapidly after the storm.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨过后河水涨得很快。

cards.example_en: The announcement said the pool would close early.
cards.example_zh: 公告上说，游泳池会提前关闭。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：焦虑的
cards.example_en: She was anxious about the job interview.

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：很多的
cards.example_en: Numerous stars were visible from the dark hillside.
cards.example_zh: 从漆黑的山坡上能看见许多星星。

cards.example_en: The captain insists that discipline is the foundation of winning.
cards.example_zh: 船长坚持认为纪律是获胜的基础。

cards.example_en: Full implementation of the recycling plan begins next month.
cards.example_zh: 回收计划的全面实施从下个月开始。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：感知；看法
cards.example_en: After the talk, his perception of the problem shifted.
cards.example_zh: 谈话之后，他对这个问题的看法变了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：所有物
cards.example_en: That old violin is his most treasured possession.
cards.example_zh: 那把旧小提琴是他最珍爱的所有物。

cards.example_en: Car production at the factory stopped for the holiday.
cards.example_zh: 假期里，这家工厂的汽车生产停了。

cards.example_en: This phone case is an accessory I bought at the mall.
cards.example_zh: 这个手机壳是我在商场买的配件。

cards.example_en: According to the teacher, the test is on Friday.
cards.example_zh: 根据老师的说法，考试在周五。
